title: ⚽️ Giant foosball game: Portugal vs. Brazil (Web Summit LIS26 session page)
what_it_says: Web Summit's session page: '⚽️ Giant foosball game: Portugal vs. Brazil', November 11, 2026, 21:00 to 21:25 (Lisbon time), Pink Street, track Night Summit. Description: 🇵🇹🇧🇷 Attendees from Portugal and Brazil: step up to the giant foosball table! This gathering offers a fun, high-energy space to connect, compete and kick off the foosball experience while meeting new people. Join us for this epic match!
